title: CTV Ads Guide: How to Advertise on CTV for Small Business

facts.fact: The guide was published on September 22, 2025.
The page states that more than 80% of US households now have at least one connected TV device; the page gives no source for this figure.
facts.quote: More than 80% of US households now have at least one connected TV device.

facts.fact: The page defines CTV ads as video advertisements delivered through internet-connected television devices, including smart TVs, streaming devices such as Roku and Apple TV, and gaming consoles connected to televisions.
facts.quote: CTV ads are video advertisements delivered through internet-connected television devices. This includes smart TVs, streaming devices like Roku and Apple TV, and gaming consoles connected to televisions.
